source_quotes: Consciousness/meta gates are decided only by meta. If meta cannot judge the walk AWAITS durably and re-judges only unjudged chunks — never fail open, never a human
the gate isn't per rule all rules we aggregate ... we notify the refinement meta loop
overlap_check: method_30 (30030) is about enforcement severity; nothing covers awaiting gates. New.

payload.name: Gates That Cannot Judge Await
payload.description: A gate decided by meta awaits durably when it cannot judge and re-judges only what was not judged. It never fails open and never hands a meta decision to a human, except for jurisdiction confirmation.

principles.name: A gate is a decision
principles.description: If it cannot decide, the answer is not 'allow'; the walk waits.

heuristics.condition: a gate has a default for when the model fails
heuristics.action: remove the default and make it await

heuristics.condition: a rule is judged inapplicable repeatedly
heuristics.action: notify the refinement meta loop; it is a signal to split or refine the methodology

decision_rules.name: Never fail open
decision_rules.condition: a meta gate cannot judge (rate limit, empty response, all calls failed)
decision_rules.outcome: await durably and retry; do not allow, deny or skip

decision_rules.name: Re-judge only the unjudged
decision_rules.outcome: re-judge only the chunks that have no judgment, keeping the ones already judged

decision_rules.name: Humans only for jurisdiction
decision_rules.outcome: let meta decide; ask a human only for a jurisdiction RequireConfirmation, through the modal

decision_rules.name: Record uncovered rules
decision_rules.condition: a rule was never judged applicable or inapplicable
decision_rules.outcome: record the uncovered rule as an event for the refinement loop
